body:
## Why
`src/dispatch.js` is the riskiest code and has no tests because everything goes through `gh`.

## What
- Add an injection point in `src/gh.js`: `setTransport(fn)` where `fn({method, path, body, kind:'rest'|'graphql', query, variables})` returns a response or throws `GhError`. Default transport = today's `spawnSync('gh', ...)`. Keep the public `rest`/`graphql`/`ghCmd` signatures unchanged.
- `test/fake-gh.js`: an in-memory GitHub (issues with labels/comments/dependencies, refs with create-if-absent returning 422 "Reference already exists" on duplicates, a minimal GraphQL resolver for the two queries `tasks.js` uses).
- `test/dispatch.test.js` covering: todo→ready promotion when all blockers close as completed (and NOT when one is NOT_PLANNED); claim held → skip; claim unknown (503) → back off, no label change; stale heartbeat → reclaimed → ready; failures > max_retries → gave_up + kb:needs-human; active_pr guard → review; path_overlap guard. Use a spawn stub (profile launch = ["true"]) so no real worker starts.

## Done when
`npm test` runs the new tests green; no new dependencies.
title: Fake-gh test harness for the dispatcher tick
